scope: Existing physical motion tasks using the shared Steward-bot Ego Runtime; assertions and internal deadlines are unchanged.

excluded.mock_or_offline: Fake actuators, planner-only and geometry-only tests do not exercise injected physical odometry or the fused control chain.
excluded.direct_physics: Direct WorldSim commands or GT-driven targets bypass the shared runtime localization chain.
excluded.independent_cobot: Independent Cobot controllers have a different pose/control integration and are outside this matrix.
excluded.sensor_or_host_only: Sensor, display, reset, HTTP access and perception-only tests without a motion task are not motion success-rate cases.
excluded.localization_benchmarks: Localization trajectory benchmarks score pose accuracy, not task success; their results remain separate.
